page.overview:
What is Hanali Celanil?

Hanali Celanil (}} ) was the elven goddess of love and beauty. However, with the coming of the Second Sundering, she was once again an independent goddess.

The goddess of love was usually portrayed as a female elf of exquisite beauty, but she could also appear as a male elf as well.

Hanali's avatar took the guise of an attractive elven maiden. She was clothed in either a short dress or a gown of gold and white. She was never wearing footwear of any kind but did have several toe rings and anklets adorning her form, all of which were gold.

Hanali was a kind, altruistic, and merciful goddess. She was quick to forgive and took joy in blessing her worshipers with loving and blissful relationships. She upheld the ideas of elven beauty and romance and encouraged delight in simple pleasures, such as the consumption of elven spirits. She was happy to see her young followers fall in love, and she would sometimes send her avatar in secret to protect them. She did, however, have the character flaws of being perhaps too fickle and flighty and a little vain.
